name: Tennessee Wesleyan University
tuition_note: 2026-27 tuition & fees ($31,820 tuition + $1,560 fees = $33,380) from tnwesleyan.edu/tuition-and-fees. Private school, single published rate. Room-only not published separately; housing_cost is combined room + board for base double (Keith/Fowler Hall, $11,200, includes unlimited meal plan). Higher halls (Nocatula, Wesley Commons) are $13,380; private rooms +$1,400/yr.
